audit.whatIsWrong: The disk chart disagreed with its own prose at five of seven rows: whys[0] says Renekton owns level 1 (chart said Skill), whys[2] says level 3 is 'even, but only if his fury bar is empty' (chart said Renekton), whys[3] says he 'reclaims levels 4-5' (chart said Skill), whys[4] calls level 6 'your cleanest kill window' (chart said Skill), whys[5] says first item 'trades evenly' (chart said Renekton).
audit.why: The packet chart (Renekton/Renekton/Skill/Renekton/Kled/Skill/Renekton) matches the prose row for row and matches the 47.61% win rate — this is a losing lane with exactly one clean Kled window at 6.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2, 3, 4 and 5 flipped in both layers as one group; rows 1 and 6 already read Renekton.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0].why said 'Mounted stats bully every level-1 exchange' on a row Renekton owns, and phases[3].why was generic template text about 'banking small leads'.
audit.why: Level 1 is his because Ruthless Predator is point-click and stuns for 0.75s, which cancels the auto sequence Violent Tendencies needs. Levels 4-5 are his because above 50 Fury that stun becomes 1.5s while Cull the Meek heals the trade back.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten to the actual mechanics and durations.
sources: champ-data/_kits/renekton.json (P Reign of Anger, Q Cull the Meek, W Ruthless Predator)

audit.whatIsWrong: Nowhere on the page does it say that empowered Ruthless Predator DESTROYS damage shields on the target.
audit.why: This is the decisive interaction of the matchup and the page recommends walking straight into it. Chaaaaaaaaarge!!! grants Kled a shield, and mid tells you to 'R-in' at level 6 — into an ability that deletes that shield and stuns you for 1.5s instead of 0.75s. Sterak's Gage, listed as a core item, is eaten the same way.
audit.corrected: mid, dontsFull[1].d and wants.foe[0] rewritten to the shield destruction, with the R commit gated on his W being spent.
sources: champ-data/_kits/renekton.json (W: 'If Renekton has more than 50 Fury, he slashes his target three times, destroying damage shields on the target... stunning them for 1.5 seconds')

audit.whatIsWrong: The stun durations were never given — 'Empowered = long stun' was the whole description.
audit.why: 0.75s versus 1.5s is the difference between surviving a bait and losing the mount. Both numbers are in Riot's text.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text now carries both durations and the point-click property.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer never mentions Grievous Wounds, even though Cull the Meek heals off every swing and is on a flat 7s.
audit.why: The full layer's itemization line already calls for Executioner's Calling, but the win-condition bullets a player actually reads do not. _missing/kled.json flags exactly this.
audit.corrected: wants.you[1] rewritten to buy Executioner's Calling early.

edits.before: Mounted stats bully every level-1 exchange. Identify how Renekton contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Ruthless Predator is point-click and stuns 0.75s, cancelling your W shots before they land — do not contest level 1.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Ruthless Predator's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Above 50 Fury his W stuns for 1.5s and destroys damage shields, while Cull the Meek heals it back — never trade into a full bar.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Empowered, it stuns 1.5s and strips your R shield outright.

edits.before: Renekton's W stun lands point-click during your W (Violent Tendencies) windup and cancels your damage — his biggest window, avoid the level-2 all-in.
edits.after: Ruthless Predator is point-click: 0.75s base, 1.5s above 50 Fury, and it cancels your W shots mid-swing — avoid the level-2 all-in entirely.

edits.before: Land empowered W stun to interrupt your W shots and re-E dash mid-combo
edits.after: Land empowered W to destroy your shield, stun 1.5s and cancel the combo

edits.before: Use Skaarl's remount sustain to recover the chip from his point-click Q and reach Level 6
edits.after: Buy Executioner's Calling early — Cull the Meek heals him through all your chip damage

edits.before: Levels 4-5 still tilt his way — a fury-stacked Renekton W-stuns into his slice-and-dice combo and heals the damage back, so don't trade into a full bar. Your turn comes at 6: Chaaaaaaaaarge!!! gives you an engage and a knockback into terrain that his kit simply can't answer, plus the gank-extension and roam he lacks. Bait his W stun out, let it whiff, then R-in, E-W-E, and Q-yank — that's your one clean window to flip the lane and snowball before his fury rhythm takes over again.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 still tilt his way — a fury-stacked Renekton W-stuns into Slice and Dice and heals the damage back, so don't trade into a full bar. Your turn comes at 6: Chaaaaaaaaarge!!! gives you an engage and a knockback into terrain his kit can't answer. Spend it only once his W is gone, though: above 50 Fury, Ruthless Predator destroys damage shields on you — including the one your charge just granted — and stuns for 1.5 seconds instead of 0.75, which is long enough for him to finish the trade on his terms.

notes: The shield-destruction clause on empowered Ruthless Predator also applies to Sterak's Gage, which report[8] lists as a core second item for this matchup.
